crew.overview: In early-1970s Las Vegas, Sam "Ace" Rothstein gets tapped by his bosses to head the Tangiers Casino. At first, he's a great success in the job, but over the years, problems with his loose-cannon enforcer Nicky Santoro, his ex-hustler wife Ginger, her con-artist ex Lester Diamond and a handful of corrupt politicians put Sam in ever-increasing danger.
crew.title: Casino

details.biography:
Frank Cullotta (December 14, 1938 – August 20, 2020) was an American mobster for the Chicago Outfit, and member of the "Hole in the Wall Gang" in Las Vegas with friend and mobster Tony Spilotro. After his arrest in 1982, he became a government witness, and entered the witness protection program. Cullotta later became an author and a tour guide.
